Brix Town references

The look every made thing is checked against. 22 references in 72 files, 9 gaps. Written from Art/Reference/catalog.json.

The town out of doors: the look, the light through the day, the weather and the sky.

The old-town alley at every hour and in every weather

WorldAlley2 issues seen
Locks
The look of the world (the old-town alley of style test 02: matte mottled plaster and stone, soft rounded forms, W1-W8) at morning, midday and dusk; at night with the lamps on, and with them off under a full and a new moon; and by day in cloud, rain, fog and snow. No haze at midday. Rain and snow fall, puddles lie with rings where the drops fall into them, and the snow lies, only where the sky is open over them: never under the passage's roof. Only the light and the weather change between them.
Approved
2026-11-26
Decision
the owner, 2026-11-26: "approved" (a reference shows every setting, not one; replaces WorldLook and the alley of WorldHours; ADR-0061)

The sky and its clouds at every hour and in every weather

WorldSky3 issues seen
Locks
The sky over the town, seen from Market Square over the roofs: blue overhead fading to the pale haze at the horizon by day, warm towards the low sun at dusk, the night's dark blue with the town's glow low down; clouds as soft heaps on one layer about 1.2 km up, flat underneath and rounded on top, lit on the sun's side and shaded underneath, pink at dusk, lit from below by the town's lamps at night; how much of the sky they cover follows the weather (clear 0.36, cloudy 0.62, rain 0.97, fog 0.55, snow 0.92); at night the stars, the Milky Way and the full moon's disc. No planet (ADR-0062).
Approved
2026-11-26, the owner
Decision
the owner, 2026-11-26: "move to sky and cloud system"; ADR-0014 (the sky and clouds), ADR-0023 (the night sky), ADR-0062 (no planet); the owner, 2026-11-26: "leave the realistic clouds as they were", then "Approve, go to Market Square"

Seen wrong, for the owner to judge

  • The rooms have three walls: the open fourth side lets in light a closed room would not have, and the game's room light was tuned to it.

  • Brightness differs widely: the bedroom, decor, garden and study are near black in the corners, the cafe bright.

How the references are kept

  • Every approved look reference is in Art/Reference/<Category>/, named <Category><Subject>[_<Variant>].<ext> in PascalCase: Indoor/IndoorRooms_Kitchen.png, Vehicles/VehiclesSoftBox.png. A reference's id is the name without the variant.
  • Art/Reference/catalog.json is the one list: what each locks, its approval and decision, the script that makes it, the game models built from it, issues seen, its old names. Agents read it there.
  • This page is written from it by python Tools/reference_catalog.py, which first checks that every file is listed and named by the rule. Never edit the page by hand.
  • A new reference: render it with its script, put it in its category's folder under its name, add it to the catalog, run the script. Changing the look needs a new ADR and the owner's approval (ADR-0004).
  • A reference taken out of use moves to Art/Retired/ and is listed under Retired.
  • Look tests and rejected ideas stay in Art/StyleTests/; they are not references.
